commands.summary: Delete Customer. Hard-deletes the customer, their microsurvey responses and every conversation they participated in, in compliance with GDPR erasure. There is no undo. Pass async=true to run it asynchronously (202 Accepted instead of 204 No Content), which is the only form that works for a customer with more than 100 conversations.
